items.title: Nothing OS 5.0 Reaches Phone (3a) and Phone (4a) Series: What’s New?
points: Nothing’s Android 17-based OS 5.0 has started rolling out to the Phone (3a) and Phone (4a) series in waves rather than all at once.
Software updates are perhaps one of the few post-purchase phenomena that give smartphone buyers some joy.

items.title: Tamil Nadu government reconstitutes State Board for Wildlife
points: The earlier board was reconstituted in April 2022, and the latest exercise follows a request from the Principal Chief Conservator of Forests and Chief Wildlife Warden after the tenure of its non-official members expired.
